categories.title: Bookings & Check-In
categories.description: Details regarding your arrival, departure, and location.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is from 3:00 PM to 11:30 PM. Check-out is from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. If you plan to arrive after 11:30 PM, please let us know in advance so we can arrange late check-in. Free luggage storage if you arrive early

items.q: Where exactly is the hostel located?
items.a: We are located at Avenida Bartolomé Mitre 1237, Mendoza, Argentina. Right in the heart of the city, just a 2-minute walk from Plaza Independencia.

items.q: Do you offer an airport shuttle?
items.a: No, we don't offer an airport shuttle. However, if you don't have a way to get to Hostel Plaza, we can arrange a ride for you upon request.
No, we don't have private parking. There are paid parking garages nearby within a few blocks.

categories.title: Payments & Cancellations
categories.description: Information on accepted methods and cancellation rules.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash, debit cards, credit cards (both local and international), and bank transfers for Argentine guests.
The reservation deposit is non-refundable. If you don't show up on your check-in date, the full amount of the reservation will be charged to your credit card.

categories.title: Facilities & Amenities
categories.description: Everything you need for a comfortable stay.

items.a: Yes, complimentary breakfast is included for all guests. Served from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

items.q: Do you have a kitchen and common areas?
items.a: Yes. We are located in a beautiful historic house with a fully equipped shared kitchen, a lovely courtyard with parrilla (BBQ) space, and a comfortable shared lounge to relax and meet other travelers.
Yes. We have fast fiber-optic Wi-Fi available for free throughout the entire hostel.

items.q: Can I leave my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
items.a: After check-out you can leave your luggage with us free of charge. For storage BEFORE check-in (if you arrive early), we recommend Bounce (bounce.com), a luggage storage service with several locations nearby.

categories.title: Rules & Policies
categories.description: Important guidelines to ensure everyone has a great time.

items.a: Yes. To maintain our atmosphere, check-in is only permitted for guests between 18 and 45 years old. Guests under 18 may only check in if accompanied by a parent or legal guardian in a private room.
Pets are allowed. Please contact us before booking to confirm availability and any applicable arrangements.

items.q: Can I smoke inside the hostel?
items.a: Smoking is strictly prohibited indoors. Smoking is only permitted in outdoor areas (patio). Smoking indoors may result in a fine and immediate expulsion from the hostel.

items.q: Does the hostel organize social events?
items.a: Yes! We host regular events including communal dinners, wine tours, paragliding trips, and rafting on the Mendoza River. See our full events calendar at https://hostelplaza.com.ar/tourist-events.

items.q: What languages does the staff speak?
items.a: Our staff speaks Spanish, English and Portuguese.

items.q: What's special about the hostel building?
items.a: Hostel Plaza occupies a beautifully preserved heritage house in the center of Mendoza. Learn more about the building and our history at https://hostelplaza.com.ar/history.
